messages:
Jamie: Hey @People Ops — I legally changed my last name this week. I need to add my partner to health + dental and update my name for payroll/W-2. What's the exact process and what docs do you need?

Maria (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: You can add a spouse/partner through Workday under Benefits > Change Dependent. For the enrollment to be effective retro to the marriage date we need proof (marriage certificate) and ID for the dependent. If you're just changing name on file, we need your updated SSN card or a name-change form from payroll.

Jamie: Thanks — can I upload scans somewhere? Also deadline questions: does this count as a qualifying life event so I can add outside open enrollment?

People Ops Bot: A support ticket #IN-2142 has been created for Jamie. Please attach documents in the ticket or reply here with a private doc link.

Maria (People Ops): Yes, this is a qualifying life event (QLE). You have 30 days from the date of the marriage to request enrollment changes that are QLE-eligible. If you miss that window we can discuss retro coverage but it requires payroll approval and may be limited.

Alex (Payroll): Hi @Jamie — for payroll/name change we need either a new Social Security card reflecting the name or a signed name-change affidavit plus the marriage certificate. Once we have docs we'll update your payroll record and next available payroll cycle will pick it up. If you want retro pay adjustments, specify the effective date in the ticket; those are handled case-by-case.

Jamie: Got it. I can upload PDFs. Is there a recommended file naming convention? Also any forms to sign for dependent coverage consent?

Ryan (Benefits Portal Bot): You can upload via the secure employee documents portal: https://docs.redwood.example/employees. Filename suggestion: `lastname_marriagecert_2026.pdf` and `lastname_partner_id_2026.pdf`. For dependent enrollment you'll complete the Workday flow; we'll email a confirmation once benefits vendor accepts dependent.

Maria (People Ops): Also a quick checklist for you: 1) Scan marriage certificate (PDF). 2) Scan partner government ID (passport/driver's). 3) Photo of both if passport issued abroad (helps verification). 4) Submit through ticket or secure portal. 5) Complete Workday dependent add flow and select coverage. We'll confirm effective date and cost impact after payroll update.

Jamie: Thanks — submitting docs now. Quick question: does adding partner change my premium pre-tax vs after-tax? I remember some plans treat domestic partners differently.
notes: This thread documents a QLE-based dependent addition + name change logistics. Short back-and-forth with bots and payroll/people-ops reps. Includes pointers to docs, deadlines (30 days), and upload instructions.
